lines.text: The same as, not same like!
Many learners say: I have the same bag like you.
Better: I have the same bag as you.
As! She has the same bag as me.

data.wrong: I have the same bag like you.
data.right: I have the same bag as you.

quiz.stem: She has the same bag ___ me.

native.tip: „Wie“ ist oft „like“. Aber nach „the same“ heißt „wie“ im Englischen „as“.

en.tip: “Wie” is often “like”. But after “the same” it is “as”.
en.caption: “Wie” after “same” is “as”! Wrong: “I have the same bag like you.” Right: “I have the same bag as you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
